title: NHK History — 武士の時代 (The Age of Samurai)
description: NHK historical programming exploring the samurai era — from their rise in the Heian period through the Edo period and Meiji abolition. Covers bushido, famous figures like Miyamoto Musashi, economic realities of samurai life, and how warrior culture still shapes modern Japanese values. N3 level with classical vocabulary.
creator: NHK
